scientific_integrity: Classical Bessel facts and annular Fourier amplitude are credited. Universality follows from an explicit analytic proof; finite numerical diagnostics are secondary, not proof of universal claims.
scientific_limitations: Real radial frequencies and concentric Euclidean annuli; no complex-zero, eccentric-shell, or arbitrary radial-density classification. The novelty assessment is self-review and may miss unindexed prior annular-optics interlacing statements.
title: Rigidity and Bessel interlacing of Fourier zeros of concentric annuli
